name: @cndiv/source-2023
description: China administrative division data snapshot for year 2023 (NBS five-level: province/city/county/township/village)

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "const s=require('fs').statSync('data/divisions.csv').size;if(s<1e6){console.error('✋ divisions.csv 缺失或过小('+s+'B)——拒绝发布空数据包(CI 无 CSV 源，须本地发布)');process.exit(1)}"
